Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Trial evaluation — ownership & success criteria (next steps)

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned before we scope the trial: 

Recap (from call)
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference as the serving layer for BlueWave’s in-app summarization + clinical search use-cases.
- Success criteria (customer-proposed): 1) latency p50 < 300ms for 2k QPS synthetic load; 2) semantic recall > 0.85 on curated eval set; 3) secure VPC peering and audit logs visible in console.

What we propose for the trial (attached): Redwood will provision a dedicated trial pool, provide a reference integration for your summarization pipeline, and run a 2-week evaluation with defined eval prompts and logs. See attached plan (redwood-trial-plan-v1.pdf).

Open items we'd like you to confirm:
1) Success criteria above — any additions or edits?
2) Who on BlueWave owns network setup (VPC peering/firewall rules) vs app integration?
3) Procurement contact for contract & PO — can you loop them in?

Next steps
- Dev and Monica will draft a lightweight RACI and a trial timeline doc (by Mon 3/30).
- If that looks good, schedule kickoff for the week of 4/6.

Attachments: redwood-trial-plan-v1.pdf

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@bluewavehealth.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial evaluation — ownership & success criteria (next steps)

Thanks Hannah — this is a helpful summary. A few notes from our side after internal sync: 

Confirmed success criteria (with small edits):
- Latency target: p50 < 300ms for interactive testing; we'll also record p95 for production signals.
- Quality: semantic recall > 0.85 on the 200-case clinical subset we'll provide.
- Security: VPC peering + audit logs; we also need an exportable evidence bundle for our InfoSec review (SOC2 artifacts, encryption-in-transit details).

Ownership on our side:
- Network/VPC peering: Infrastructure (Tom Alvarez)
- App integration (summarization pipeline + API calls): Platform Engineering (we'll confirm owner, likely Sara)
- Procurement: I'll loop procurement once we have a draft SOW/estimate.

Attaching our security questionnaire (BlueWave_security_questions.pdf) — please review and flag any hard blockers. Also: procurement will want an estimated monthly run rate for the trial if we exceed committed tokens; please include ballpark in the draft SOW.

Happy to chat next week to align on timeline.

Attachments: BlueWave_security_questions.pdf

Best,
Sara Klein
Head of Platform, BlueWave Health
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@bluewavehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@bluewavehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial evaluation — ownership & success criteria (next steps)

Sara / Tom — thanks for the quick turn. I pulled together an ownership (RACI-style) snapshot and a proposed 3-week trial timeline below. Happy to adapt based on your internal owners.

Proposed RACI (high level)
- Network / VPC peering: Responsible: BlueWave (Tom); Accountable: BlueWave Infra; Consulted: Dev Patel (Redwood); Informed: Hannah, Monica
- Redwood trial infra provisioning (dedicated trial pool, model pinning, logging): Responsible: Dev Patel (Redwood); Accountable: Redwood SRE team; Consulted: BlueWave Infra; Informed: Hannah
- App integration + sample workloads: Responsible: BlueWave Platform Eng (Sara/TBD); Accountable: BlueWave Eng Manager; Consulted: Dev Patel (Redwood) for SDK and reference impl; Informed: Monica
- Security evidence & questionnaire responses: Responsible: Monica Patel (Redwood) + BlueWave InfoSec contact; Accountable: Monica; Consulted: Neha Kapoor; Informed: Hannah
- Procurement / billing estimates: Responsible: Hannah Schmitt (Redwood) + BlueWave procurement; Accountable: Hannah; Consulted: Neha

Proposed timeline (targeted)
- Week 0 (4/6): Kickoff, confirm owners, exchange network details and security expectations.
- Week 1 (4/7–4/13): Redwood provisions trial pool; BlueWave completes VPC peering and app-side integration (sample traffic).
- Week 2 (4/14–4/20): Validation run, collect metrics and logs; run semantic recall eval against BlueWave subset.
- Week 3 (4/21–4/27): Analysis, tuning, and final go/no-go decision; deliverables: trial report + recommended production profile.

Attachments I can share now: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx (list of artifacts we can provide), and an updated trial-plan draft (link: https://docs.redwood.ai/share/trial-plan-BW-v1).

Open questions for BlueWave
- Can you confirm the Platform Engineering owner for app integration (name/email)?
- Any hard constraints on data retention / log access window?
- Procurement lead we should include on the SOW draft?

I can jump on a 30m call this week if useful.

Thanks — Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@bluewavehealth.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sara Klein <sara.klein@bluewavehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Trial evaluation — ownership & success criteria (next steps)

Appreciate the clarity Dev. Quick notes from infra / procurement: 

- We can own VPC peering but need Redwood playbook for the firewall rules and required subnets (can you supply a one-pager?).
- For the trial, we prefer a private deployment model (VPC + customer-managed peering) rather than a multi-tenant hosted trial. Is that supported for a short-term evaluation?
- Procurement: copying procurement@bluewavehealth.com. They'll need an itemized SOW and an estimated spend cap for the trial.

Please include the VPC checklist and a draft SOW with run-rate estimates in the updated trial plan. If you can get that to procurement this week, we can accelerate.

-Tom
Tom Alvarez
Infrastructure Lead, BlueWave Health
